scope: Local memory investigation; no source media, frames, PCM or user-browser contents retained.

revisions.sharedAfter: 1.2.1 working tree; final lock records the canonical commit

notes: Post-clear samples use two CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage requests separated by 120 ms. A WeakRef does not keep the measured object alive.
Heap backingStorageSize measures array/external-string backing storage, not all native/GPU/audio memory. RSS includes browser allocation pools and is not a live-object count.
First baseline loop was paused by overlapping transport intents and is invalid as a playback measurement. Its load/clear samples and heap snapshot remain valid.
First fixed run completed eight load/clear cycles, but its restarted post-scrub video did not keep looping. The new positive playback check stopped that measurement. No steady-play claim uses it.
Final loop run uses one play command after settled pause, confirms native looping and active playback, and does not force collection during the 90-second interval.
Runs were isolated muted Chrome 152.0.7977.83. Default browser suite uses Chromium 145.0.7632.6.

baselineHeapSnapshot.contextRetainer: The same active AudioWorkletNode retains its AudioContext.
baselineHeapSnapshot.lastVideoRetainer: primaryVideoRef retains the most recently removed video; older videos collected. Bounded retention, distinct from the per-load audio leak.
baselineHeapSnapshot.omitted: Full 8.1 MiB heap snapshot stays local scratch; selected counts/retainer chain and a reproducible capture command are retained here.
